services.name: SIP & Stroll River Rides
services.desc: Cruise with us to and from the monthly Sip & Stroll event that occurs the third Monday of each Month from 5-8 pm! We will depart from Riverfront Plaza on the Northbank at 5 pm and will drop you at Sip & Stroll. We will provide return trips from the Southbank to the Northbank at 7 pm, 7:30 pm, and 8 pm! Spanning from the DoubleTree Hotel to The Southbank Hotel, enjoy live music, food vendors, bars and a picnic area – all with a picturesque sunset backdrop. Alcoholic beverages in a branded Sip & Stroll cup are permitted on the Riverwalk during the event and are provided at either one of the Cruise to and from Sip & Stroll or take a short ride ON THE RIVER!

services.name: River Transportation - Dock to Dock Transfer or 20-Min Loop -
Downtown Sightseeing Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy an educational and informative cruise on the St. Johns! We depart from the Doubletree Hotel Dock, just east of the Main Street Bridge on the Southbank Riverwalk. This narrated tour includes a brief history about Jacksonville, information about the St. Johns River and a chance to get a close look at wildlife that abounds in the downtown area. All ages are welcome on this tour. Please understand that dolphin sightings are very common but not guaranteed. 1 Hour - Boarding is 10 minutes prior to published departures. We depart from Doubletree Hotel Dock, 32207. Behind Doubletree 1 Hour · All ages · City Sites

services.name: River Transportation - Dock to Dock Transit
services.desc: Round-trip water taxi providing flexible transit between public downtown docks (advance purchase required). Jump aboard and cruise to your destination!

services.name: Downtown Sunset Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy a relaxing Sunset Cruise! All ages are welcome on our Sunset Tour however, but it is geared toward adults - a nice “date night” option. 1 hour and 15 minutes. About Enjoy a beautiful sunset, a relaxing cruise and great music on board our large passenger pontoon boat! Depending on weather conditions, we will either cruise North past the sports complex and toward Exchange Island or South toward Riverside, Avondale, and San Marco. WE BOARD 15 MIN PRIOR TO PUBLISHED DEPARTURE TIME FROM DOUBLETREE HOTEL DOCK BOARDING LOCATION, 1201 Riverplace Blvd., Jacksonville, FL 32207. Wine, 1.25 Hrs · All ages · Our most Popular!

services.name: Dazzling City Lights Cruise
services.desc: Join us for a cruise on the St. Johns and a waterside seat to see the incredible water and light show at Friendship Fountain Park! Our downtown buildings are awash with color and the bridges are all illuminated! Perfect for date night. We depart from the downtown Doubletree Dock, just behind the Doubletree Hotel, 1201 Riverplace Blvd. Wine & Beer available for purchase on board. We always hope that weather conditions will be perfect, but some things are simply out of our control. We would still go out if it is slightly drizzling, but if we have to cancel due to foul weather we will offer a CRUISE ENDS WITH FRIENDSHIP FOUNTAIN LIGHT SHOW!

services.name: Round Trip River Taxi Game Transport
services.desc: Take the River Taxi to and from the game! River Taxi service begins at least three hours before the game starts and continues until the Stadium dock is clear. We operate multiple boats and extend service hours for all game days. Please select your dock preference below. On game day, you simply go to the dock and check in to get your round trip wristband. For stadium transport, we pick up from two downtown river taxi docks on the Southbank (Doubletree and Marriott SOUTHBANK) and one dock on the Northbank (east end of Riverfront Plaza under the Blue Bridge). We will loop approximately every 25 CRUISE WITH US TO THE GAME!!

services.name: Downtown Dolphin Cruise
services.desc: Relaxing 60-minute dolphin-watching cruise on the St. Johns River departing from the Doubletree Hotel Dock.

services.name: July 4th Sunset & Fireworks Cruise
services.desc: Sunset cruise on the St. Johns River culminating in Jacksonville’s 250th birthday fireworks viewing. Departing from Doubletree Hotel Dock, 1201 Riverplace Blvd.

services.name: Monster Jam Round Trip Transport
services.desc: Cruise with us to and from the Monster Jam show at TIAA Bank Field! This is a round trip ticket that can be used as a hop on - hop off pass. We will operate until after the show is over, getting you back to your departure dock! For transport to the Stadium Dock, we will make two stops on the Southbank and one stop one the Northbank. Please select your dock preference below. We will start event transport at 4 pm and loop every 20 min or so. The event starts at 7 Drops off across the street from TIAA Bank Field

services.name: Help Us Support the St. Johns Riverkeeper! $5 River Ride!
services.desc: Cruise the river and support your Riverkeeper! We will give all proceeds collected from this trip to St Johns Riverkeeper!

services.name: Riverkeeper & Friends Cruise
services.desc: Enjoy a relaxing Dolphin Cruise! 75 min cruise. About Join us for a relaxing cruise on the St. Johns! We will depart from the Doubletree Hotel Dock, 1201 Riverplace Blvd., 32207, and cruise east toward Exchange Island where dolphin like to roam. Wine & Beer sold on board! It’s a great way to unwind before a great dinner downtown. WE BOARD 10 MIN PRIOR TO PUBLISHED DEPARTURE TIME! We look forward to seeing you on the river! If we don't reach our minimum capacity for our tours to go out, we will reach out to reschedule. What to bring: - Snacks, appetizers - Light jacket - Your
